purpose: The fleet-wide roster of coding surfaces that report token usage, and the providers each surface is expected to report. A surface that publishes nothing is still listed here, so its absence is visible as unknown coverage instead of silently missing from the total.
expected_basis: Captain order 2026-10-21: 'I want all tokens used aggregated', 'every token, every account, every surface'. The provider set {agy, codex, glm, minimax} is the fleet's coding-provider set; the Captain named codex (two accounts across surfaces), minimax (two accounts), the Gemini/Antigravity account and glm.

surfaces.label: Controller (Crisp-R)
surfaces.notes: The Captain's own surface and the one the board runs on. 'Crisp-R' is the Captain's name for this session; it is an alias of this surface, not a separate host, so it never gets its own row in a total. Any usage-side account it reports is an unmapped local subset with unknown identity and stays marked `unknown_local_subset`, because the usage side does not map onto a quota-side key.

surfaces.label: HD2Stack
surfaces.notes: The fleet's primary firstmate and execution surface. Usage rows for this surface already exist inside the Controller's owner ledger; a published surface-usage document adds the days that ledger does not carry. Any usage-side account it reports is an unmapped local subset with unknown identity and stays marked `unknown_local_subset`, because the usage side does not map onto a quota-side key.

surfaces.label: Hetz (brandon-compute)
surfaces.notes: Reached over the sanctioned comms route only. This lane never reads or writes the Hetz host. Any usage-side account it reports is an unmapped local subset with unknown identity and stays marked `unknown_local_subset`, because the usage side does not map onto a quota-side key.

surfaces.label: Elevate VPS (KVM1)
surfaces.notes: The fourth coding surface in the roster. Listed so its absence from the token total is visible as unknown coverage, not as a quiet omission. Any usage-side account it reports is an unmapped local subset with unknown identity and stays marked `unknown_local_subset`, because the usage side does not map onto a quota-side key.

provider_notes.agy: Measured from the canonical Antigravity brain transcript on the surface that runs it: input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens, counted once per event. A surface with no such transcript has no local Gemini/Antigravity token source, so its agy slot stays unknown; quota-axi reports the Gemini windows, which is a different field.
